nodes.summary: When some event survives, event `j` gets probability zero iff `N j ≤ α`.
nodes.title: Elimination
Nonnegativity of the GPS M-step update

nodes.summary: When every event survives, the update is `(N j - α) / ∑ k, (N k - α)`.
nodes.title: GPS M-step formula when every event survives

nodes.summary: When some event survives, event `j` keeps positive probability iff `α < N j`.
nodes.title: GPS M-step keeps positive probability exactly on surviving events

nodes.summary: With `α = 0` and nonnegative counts the update is the ordinary mixture M-step `N j / ∑ N`.
nodes.title: GPS M-step at zero sparseness is the ordinary mixture M-step

nodes.summary: `π j = max (N j - α) 0 / ∑ k, max (N k - α) 0`.
nodes.title: The GPS M-step with component elimination

nodes.summary: When every remaining event survives (`α < N j` for all `j`), the update maximizes the GPS expected complete-data log penalized likelihood over the positive probability vectors.
nodes.title: The M-step of the restructured model

nodes.summary: The expected complete-data log penalized likelihood of GPS, up to an additive constant: `∑ j, (N j - α) log (π j)` (the expected log-likelihood `∑ j, N j log (π j)` plus the log of the negative Dirichlet prior). Meaningful for positive `π`.
nodes.title: Expected penalized complete-data log-likelihood of GPS

nodes.summary: The update sums to one when some event survives.
nodes.title: GPS M-step update sums to one when some event survives

nodes.summary: The total surviving weight is positive iff some event has `α < N j`.
nodes.title: Total surviving weight is positive iff some event survives

nodes.summary: The surviving weight `max (N j - α) 0` of event `j`, for expected read counts `N` and sparseness parameter `α`.
nodes.title: Surviving weight of a GPS event

nodes.summary: When every event survives, the penalized and truncated objectives agree.
nodes.title: Truncated and penalized objectives agree when every event survives

nodes.summary: The update is an upper bound for the truncated objective over the positive probability vectors (derived characterization of the elimination rule). Upper-bound statement only: this does not prove the value at `mStep` is the supremum (no approximation or `sSup` theorem is given). When elimination occurs `mStep` itself is not a positive vector (eliminated coordinates are zero), so it is the boundary point on the face…
nodes.title: The update is an upper bound for the truncated objective

nodes.summary: The truncated objective `∑ j, max (N j - α) 0 * log (π j)`.
nodes.title: Truncated GPS objective
